# bit recursion
full=(1<<len(coords))-1
# candidate lists by cell in placement tuple
nodes=0; solution=None
# identical piece indices groups
same_groups=[[1,2,3,4],[7,9]]
def search(occ,used,chosen):
    global nodes,solution
    nodes+=1
    if occ==full:
        if used==(1<<len(piece_specs))-1:
            solution=chosen.copy(); return True
        return False
    best=None; bestopts=None
    rem=full^occ
    while rem:
        lb=rem&-rem; i=lb.bit_length()-1; rem-=lb
        opts=[]
        for p in bycell[i]:
            pi,b,*_=p
            if used>>pi&1 or b&occ: continue
            # symmetrical duplicates only allow lowest currently unused
            skip=False
            for group in same_groups:
                if pi in group and any(not (used>>q&1) for q in group if q<pi):
                    skip=True;break
            if not skip: opts.append(p)
        if bestopts is None or len(opts)<len(bestopts):
            best=i;bestopts=opts
            if not opts:return False
            if len(opts)==1: break
    for p in bestopts:
        pi,b,*_=p
        if search(occ|b,used|(1<<pi),chosen+[p]): return True
    return False
res=search(0,0,[])
print(res,nodes,solution and [(piece_specs[p[0]][0],p[2:]) for p in solution])
